Author: Subhash Chandra Sharma
Bench: Subhash Chandra Sharma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 80
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Cancellation Application No. - 579 of 2022
Applicant :- Mohd Tahir

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 6 Others Counsel for Applicant :-
Dinesh Kumar Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.

Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard Sri Shivam Tripathi, learned advocate holding brief of Sri Dinesh Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.
This bail cancellation application (under section 439(2) Cr.P.C.) has been moved seeking cancellation of bail of the opposite party nos.2 to 7 in Case Crime No.229 of 2022, under sections 498A, 323, 354Kha, 307, 504, 506, 325 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act & Section 4 of Muslim Women (Protection of Right on Marriage) Act-2019, Police Station Khoda, District Ghaziabad, during the pendency of investigation/trial.

entities.text: Muslim Women (Protection of Right on Marriage) Act-2019,
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Facts in brief are that the opposite party no.2 Gul Mohammad is husband whose regular bail was granted by the learned court below and opposite party nos.3 to 7 are father-in-law, mother-in-law and nanads who were granted anticipatory bail by co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Criminal Misc.

entities.text:
Criminal Misc.
Mohd Tahir vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Anticipatory Bail Application No.7342 of 2022 vide order dated 01.09.2022 against which present bail cancellation application has been filed.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the opposite party nos.2 to 7 have concealed the facts regarding their address and obtained the bail from this court regarding which he has filed an application u/s 340 Cr.P.C. before the learned court concerned which is still pending.

It is further submitted that there were injuries on the person of wife/victim but those injuries were not taken into consideration by this Court at the time of passing the aforesaid order dated 01.09.2022 and also they are violating the conditions imposed on them by this Court.
Learned A.G.A. has the prayer as aforesaid and urged that regarding wrong address of the opposite party no.2 to 7

learned counsel for the applicant has filed an application u/s 340 Cr.P.C. which is still pending consideration before the learned trial court so during pendency of the aforesaid application no cancellation of bail can be made on that very ground.

It is also urged that the husband of opposite party no.2 Gul Mohammad was granted regular bail by the learned court of session, therefore, that bail cannot be cancelled in this application which is for cancellation of anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perusal of record, there appears no ground to cancel regular bail of opposite party no.2 as well as the anticipatory bail granted in favour of the opposite party nos.3 to 7 at this stage.
Accordingly, this bail cancellation application is, hereby, rejected.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Ashok Gupta  Mohd Tahir vs State Of U.P. And 6 Others on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50198029/
